phases.name: Script to AI Agent Migration
phases.description: Converting dumb polling scripts to intelligent AI-powered agents using Claude, Codex, and Gemini SDKs
goals: Replace polling loops with reasoning loops
Add AI SDK integrations (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google)
Transform monitoring scripts into intelligent agents
expected_changes: Import anthropic SDK for Claude agents
Import openai SDK for Codex agents
Import google.generativeai SDK for Gemini agents
New async def reason() methods replacing polling
New AgentPurpose classes defining agent missions
New AgentDecision dataclasses for decision tracking
Replacement of simple polling loops with intelligent reasoning
Addition of tool definitions for SDK function calling
validation_criteria: All agents must have async def reason() method
All agents must use SDK for LLM calls
All agents must log decisions for learning
All agents must adapt their check intervals intelligently
Protection agents must check evolution context before blocking

metadata.purpose: Track intentional system evolution phases to prevent protection systems from reverting progress
